recorded_by: Trusted Sol secretary for the actual independent Astra decision; not a model substitution

horizon.start: recorded T0 before first authorized implementation turn

accounting.preserve: all historical totals, six failures, receipts, source and proposal pins; old 750k is not new debt
accounting.scope: every root, worker, reviewer, probe, model and resume
accounting.identity: provider request ID where available; otherwise stable thread/run/counter-epoch plus event identity; resumes retain identity unless counter reset is proven
accounting.method: deduplicate overlapping sources per identity, union disjoint usage, derive cumulative deltas within each epoch; retain corrections and provenance; never max aggregate DB and telemetry sums
accounting.baseline: snapshot all known cumulative counters at T0; retain pre-T0 history separately; unknown history is unresolved, never zero
accounting.subsets: uncached_input=input-cached_input; cached_input is within input; reasoning is within output; reject inconsistent counters
accounting.turn: persist start and end counters and charge their delta, including retries; use request receipts where concurrent usage prevents attribution
accounting.late: append corrections and attribute by event interval; pre-T0 usage stays historical; ambiguous intervals retain reservations until resolved
accounting.missing: reserve the full authorized turn ceiling before dispatch; retain it for missing or in-flight receipts; inadequate bounds or exhausted reserve pause dispatch

planning.unit: WPU: internal work proxy only, neither billed credits nor subscription allowance
planning.formula: sum(rate times corresponding token count divided by 1000000)
planning.reserve_rule: unavailable for discretionary work; unknown usage exceeding or lacking a defensible bound within its reservation pauses work; historical reservation is uncertainty protection, not a new charge

renewal.authority: ordinary Sol coordinator after independent review
renewal.requires: reconciled ledger, remaining envelope, current quota and approved pinned scope

planning.enforcement: reserve before dispatch and check during execution; stop at the first applicable ceiling; overflow consumes reserve and pauses dispatch; all execution, review and controller inference counts

quota.reduced_mode: one team; halve WPU and token turn ceilings
quota.growth_pause: increase of at least 1 percentage point within 15 minutes
quota.growth_resume: Sol may resume only below 69 after 30 minutes paused and two stable readings at least 5 minutes apart, in reduced mode
quota.poll: before dispatch, after completion, and every 5 minutes while active
quota.stale_or_unavailable: no dispatch without a reading within 5 minutes; pause active work if entitlement cannot be verified
quota.other_stops: ordinaryUsageAllowed=false, explicit provider limit, or inability to enforce no-paid-credit use
quota.reset: no automatic budget or quota-threshold rebasing, including at the reported weekly reset
quota.no_idle: no idle model turns, heartbeat inference or standing workers; sleeping infrastructure may read quota without inference

concurrency.team: one Sol and at most one confined Luna; coordinator and reviewers count toward these limits

release.bootstrap_only: accounting repair, deterministic local verification and release evidence in candidate under STOP
release.requires: independent Sol review of exact candidate commit; bounded actual Luna confined work; counter-reset/resume/dedup/late-data and turn-delta verification; enforced budget, quota and STOP behavior; closure of applicable security and qualification gaps
release.approval: record exact reviewed pins and permitted scope before lifting STOP through its supported mechanism
release.broader_resume: goal, worker and supervisor resume require their own covered release gates; no inferred approval from bootstrap
release.unattended_maintainer: not qualified by the interactive handoff

governance.exhaustion: stop and record evidence; no automatic CEO escalation or renewal beyond this envelope
governance.restrictions: all existing protected-data, acquisition, training, trading, main and remote restrictions remain

verdict: Yes: the reported arithmetic reconciles: 1,874,998 + 254,590 + 132,844 + 80,447 = 2,342,879; 2,047,232 cached + 295,647 other tokens matches. This does not establish subscription consumption or newly incurred debt against the old 750k threshold. No blanket cumulative-notification duplication is demonstrated. The supervisor nevertheless has accounting defects: aggregate max reconciliation misses disjoint usage, external roots/probes are omitted, and lifetime counters are unsuitable as turn deltas. STOP remains justified by six failed attempts, zero accepted tasks and unresolved release gates.
authorization: Approve the bounded repair bootstrap and conditional Sol renewals above. Implementation may begin only after this decision episode hands off and the decision is durably recorded. Authorize a separate native gpt-6.1-sol task only after verifying High reasoning and an independent root identity; it must use confined Luna6 High work and independent pinned-release review. This authorizes the downstream handoff, not an execution or delegation performed here. No controller implementation, pilot STOP bypass, paid credits or future automatic Astra.
limitations: Decision uses the supplied verified dossier and official pricing excerpt; no tools, persistence, implementation or dispatch occurred. Root counter movement is 3,118,431, but its interval is not established as comparable to the stop snapshot. Historical 213,291 must not be added again without provenance proving exclusion from the supplied totals. Model-specific input/output attribution is insufficient to reconstruct historical WPU. Killed-chief usage, late arrivals and post-stop root context remain unresolved. Coarse quota percentages cannot prove zero usage or guarantee a maximum overshoot; internal reservations cannot enforce provider billing limits. Missing enforceable bounds require a pause.
